I don't know, can you try? it will take around 9 days to exit validator on new testnet to test it out through the launchpad its not possible This is my validator https://zhejiang.beaconcha.in/validator/61001 That I have exited already launchpad is going to detect that a deposit has been made already for the validator and does not care about it being exited. what if we directly call the deposit function in the contract instead of calling via launchpad , will it work the deposit will go through and the beacon chain will process it, but it will never re-activate the validator the validator balance on the beacon chain will increase until the next scheduled ~~partial~~ full withdrawal see: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#deposits in particular ```python if pubkey not in validator_pubkeys: # we don't take this branch ... else: # we *do* take this branch # Increase balance by deposit amount index = ValidatorIndex(validator_pubkeys.index(pubkey)) increase_balance(state, index, amount) ``` what will happen in the next partial withdrawal, will be get that balance back i think we only get partial if balance is grater than 32 eth, and if we are able to add balance in the validator once is exited and lets say we added 32, will it not become active then too? ah yeah sorry, it's not a partial withdrawal but another full withdrawal see: <https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/capella/beacon-chain.md#is_fully_withdrawable_validator> yes, you get the balance back in the withdrawal address there's no code path where inactive validators become active again, that's definitely impossible even if you get to 32 ETH okay, thanks <@602753420033785856> very helpful How did you initiate the voluntary-exit?

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
the deposit will go through and the beacon chain will process it, but it will never re-activate the validator

the validator balance on the beacon chain will increase until the next scheduled ~~partial~~ full withdrawal

see: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#deposits

in particular

```python
if pubkey not in validator_pubkeys:
  # we don't take this branch
  ...
else:
  # we *do* take this branch
  # Increase balance by deposit amount
  index = ValidatorIndex(validator_pubkeys.index(pubkey))
  increase_balance(state, index, amount)
```
